|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle]], under the original title. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-02-Rebel_Agents_Blaster_Rifle-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The release-sheet slip shows the original text (see [[Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle]]); the current text is [[Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' ([[Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle]]): printed as •Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 8, slip 47 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Rebel Agent. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (two if Scoundrel's Luck on table). Character or creature hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. Vehicle hit if total destiny -2 > defense value.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Kyle_Katarns_Blaster_Rifle.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), still titled Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle, dropped “its” and both “total”s and added a comma (“Vehicle hit, if”)<ref name="cl-1281_47-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Deploy on Rebel Agent. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (two if Scoundrel's Luck on table). Character or Creature hit, and forfeit = 0, if destiny > defense value. Vehicle hit, if destiny -2 > defense value.” (From 12 December 2012 the Virtual Block 8 list prints “and it's forfeit = 0”, while the Virtual Master list (VMasterType) keeps “and forfeit = 0” to 11 January 2013; that added word waits for a ruling, so it is not a separate version.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-02-Rebel_Agents_Blaster_Rifle-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 54)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=54, page 54. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=54 Internet Archive]</ref> retitled the card •Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle (Rebel Agent became Kyle Katarn) and printed the sheet wording with “Deploy on Kyle Katarn.”: “Deploy on Kyle Katarn. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (two if Scoundrel's Luck on table). Character or creature hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. Vehicle hit if total destiny -2 > defense value.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-47-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-kylekatarnsblasterrifle-pre.gif]], undated) print it. The PC website card list showed the new title, without text, by 13 March 2013.
